content: FastAPI CORSMiddleware must be added before route declarations; set allow_origins=['http://localhost:5173'] explicitly (Vite's default dev port) -- allow_origins=['*'] is rejected by browsers when allow_credentials=True. Alternative: Vite dev-server proxy (server.proxy in vite.config.ts forwarding /api to the FastAPI port) avoids CORS entirely by making requests same-origin from the browser's perspective -- simpler for a local hackathon demo than maintaining an allow-list.
